# copick add alignment

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Add an alignment of a tilt series from AreTomo3, Warp, RELION or IMOD files.*

## Usage

```bash
copick add alignment [OPTIONS] PATH
```

## Description

Converts the tool's per-image tilt, rotation and shift to copick's CETS frame, mapping the tool's rows to the
sections of the tilt series (by default AreTomo3 by ascending angle, Warp and RELION by nominal angle, IMOD by
index). Only rigid alignments are stored; local ones need --rigid-only (AreTomo3) or --allow-varying-grids (Warp).

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `PATH` | AreTomo3 .aln, Warp tilt-series .xml, RELION tomograms.star, or IMOD basename / .xf. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--run` | text | **required** | The run. |
| `--format` | choice (aretomo3 \| warp \| relion \| imod) | **required** | Format of PATH. |
| `--ts-type` | text | `raw` | The tilt series the alignment aligns. |
| `--name` | text | — | Name of the alignment. Default: the format. |
| `--tomo-name` | text | — | RELION: the tomogram, if the file lists several. |
| `--reference-tomogram` | text | — | The tomogram ('tomo_type@voxel_size') the tool reconstructed with this alignment; it becomes the reference volume and is linked. |
| `--volume-size` | text | — | Size 'x,y,z' of the tool's reconstruction in pixels of the aligned stack, overriding the files. |
| `--thickness` | integer | — | Thickness of the tool's reconstruction in pixels (AreTomo3 -VolZ), overriding the files. |
| `--native-pixel-size` | float | — | Pixel size of the stack the tool aligned, if not that of the tilt series (e.g. a binned stack). |
| `--link-tomogram` | text · multiple | — | A tomogram ('tomo_type@voxel_size') reconstructed with this alignment. Repeatable. |
| `--preferred` | boolean flag | `False` | Prefer this alignment over the tilt series' others. |
| `--ctf` | file | — | CTF fits to store on the tilt series (e.g. the AreTomo3 _CTF.txt). |
| `--ctf-format` | choice (aretomo3 \| ctffind4 \| warp \| relion) | — | Format of --ctf. Default: from its name. |
| `--tlt` | file | — | AreTomo3 _TLT.txt whose acquisition order and dose to store on the tilt series. |
| `--update-tilt-series / --no-update-tilt-series` | boolean flag | `True` | Store --ctf and --tlt on the tilt series (writable tilt series only). |
| `--section-map` | choice (auto \| index \| sorted \| angle) | `auto` | How the rows of a file map to tilt-series sections: 'auto' (the file's default), 'index' (row i is section i), 'sorted' (rows in ascending angle pair with sections in ascending nominal angle) or 'angle' (nearest nominal angle). |
| `--angle-tolerance` | float | `1.0` | Largest difference in degrees between a row's angle and the nominal angle of its section. |
| `--assume-frame` | choice (half \| floor) | — | IMOD only: centre convention (N/2 or floor(N/2)) for odd image or volume sizes. |
| `--rigid-only` | boolean flag | `False` | Import the rigid part of a local (patch) AreTomo3 alignment; the local part is lost. |
| `--allow-varying-grids` | boolean flag | `False` | Warp only: drop spatially varying deformation grids; only the rigid part is kept. |
| `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` | boolean flag | `False` | Replace an existing alignment. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
# An AreTomo3 alignment with its CTF fits; the reconstruction is linked
copick add alignment TS_01.aln --format aretomo3 --run TS_01 --ctf TS_01_CTF.txt \
    --tlt TS_01_TLT.txt --reference-tomogram aretomo3@7.7 -c config.json

# A RELION 5 alignment
copick add alignment tomograms.star --format relion --run TS_01 --tomo-name TS_01 -c config.json
```
